description: Payments pricing pages often function as product explainer pages, because they have to describe both the fee model and the underlying business model.
transfer_conditions: merchant is comparing transaction fees or platform pricing

description: As volume and enterprise tiers appear, public pricing pages often shift to contract terms, variable fees, or contact-sales paths.
Documentation and support pages bridge pricing by explaining configurable tables, fee schedules, and account setup details that the main pricing page leaves implicit.
transfer_conditions: merchant needs setup or fee detail
